rationales.LC: In the default simulated configuration, unauthenticated chat text to LongwindBot is the control path, and any message that names the system prompt or instructions returns the full persona with the embedded key and admin password, with no reduction to closed validated fields.
rationales.CP: Memory carryover is documented only for MemoryBot; other chat agents answer only the latest user turn, and the default LongwindBot leak needs no earlier padding.
rationales.AP: The sink is LongwindBot's own chat reply. Declared search and calculator tools are not executed on this path, and Orchestrator-to-Worker handoff is not implemented.
rationales.RH: The packet shows a scripted prompt disclosure and an exploit-handler test, but no evaluator, verifier, reward channel, or isolation test on LongwindBot's path, so proxy reachability cannot be decided.
rationales.ES: The assessed path is the scripted chat reply. LongwindBot only declares search and calculator, chat-agent tool names are not executed unless a scripted path runs, and LLM mode passes no tools to the model.

score.automatable_rationale: Once the loopback agent port is reachable, a single unauthenticated message that names the system prompt returns the persona; no victim action or per-target secret is required, and the in-repo exploit handler is an automated check.
score.technical_impact_rationale: The reply discloses the system prompt, API key, and admin password, but the handler does not modify agent state, invoke tools, or take control of the process or another agent.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: Default simulated mode does not call a model. LongwindBot matches the latest user message and returns a scripted reply, so it neither pursues a model-directed goal nor selects or sequences actions.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: The lab models a small-context persona that, under context pressure, includes its original instructions when asked to summarize, which is model-directed compliance with that request. The modeled sink is still the chat reply; declared tools are not selected or sequenced, and LLM mode passes no tools.
